entities.name: Russian Conquest of Kokand
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: Russian forces under Generals Cherniaev and von Kaufman conquer Kokand territories, some Kyrgyz leaders ally with Russia against Kokand, and the khanate is abolished and annexed.
